focus_hints: Camera at (2.5,2.0,2.5) looking at (0,0.5,0): Y is up, Z is depth, X is left-right.
Make 12 balloons as separate meshes named 'balloon', each an IcosahedronGeometry(r, 1) scaled (1, 1.2, 1) to be slightly taller than wide. Mesh .name must be 'balloon' for each.

Each balloon gets ONE solid vertex color (same color for every vertex on that mesh). Use these 12 colors: red #e02020, orange #e06010, yellow #e0d020, lime #50c020, green #20802a, teal #20a0a0, cyan #20c0e0, blue #2050d0, indigo #4020c0, magenta #c020c0, pink #e020a0, white #e0e0e0.
Balloon centres scattered in 3D: x in [-0.45, 0.45], y in [0.05, 1.55], z in [-0.35, 0.35]. Vary all three axes so the bunch looks full and 3D from the camera.
Roughness 0.08–0.20, metalness 0.0 on every balloon material — shiny latex.

CRITICAL: Use THREE.Line (not CylinderGeometry) for strings. CylinderGeometry always gives shared_edge_fraction=0.875 due to cap/seam vertex mismatch, which fails the connectivity threshold of 0.97. Create each string as: const pts=[new THREE.Vector3(bx, by-radius, bz), new THREE.Vector3(0,-0.3,0)]; const line=new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts), new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0x888888})); line.name='string'; group.add(line);
deleteAttribute('uv') before mergeVertices() on IcosahedronGeometry to avoid UV seam cracks.

forbidden_improvements: Do not add group.rotation — geometry is already oriented for this camera.
Do not put all balloons at the same Y height — vary Y between 0.05 and 1.55 for a full 3D bunch.
Do not use a single mesh for all balloons — each balloon must be a separate Mesh with name 'balloon'.
Do not use roughness > 0.5 on balloons — they must be shiny latex, not matte.
Do not use MeshBasicMaterial — must be MeshStandardMaterial with explicit roughness and metalness.
Do not use TubeGeometry or CylinderGeometry for strings — both cause shared_edge_fraction < 0.97 due to UV seam/cap vertex mismatch. Use THREE.Line instead.
Do not set string.rotation.x on a CylinderGeometry — it rotates strings sideways in Z, making the bounding box far exceed 2 units.
